title: Prompt archive project latest-response slot v1
description: A durable, immutable wrapper in the project-global ordered latest-response sidecar chain. The one physical cross-process lock is collocated with and deterministically derived from the external latest-response target, so default legacy writers without archive-root configuration can find it; it is never derived from response, sprint, archive, operation, runtime-root, or archive-root identity. The wrapper persists the predecessor-independent intent_id and complete order tuple so recovery can prove equal, earlier, or later intent without freezing a mutable predecessor in the plan. Under the lock: an equal intent is success; a greater current order makes an older operation a safe superseded no-op; a lower current order derives generation=current+1 and previous_slot_id=current, then reconciles content bytes and sidecar before unlock. Bootstrap is two-phase: under this lock it observes the legacy bytes and durably publishes intended content plus retained/current enrollment markers, releases the lock, registers under the pending-registry shard lock alone, then reacquires this lock to revalidate and reconcile content and the first slot. Each wrapper is immutable and content-addressed. Descriptor and every normal legacy transition, identity, state, or rollback participate in this same serialization chain.

latest_slot_id.description: PAS1-ID-v1 latest-slot-id over the flattened ordered scalar fields frozen by PROMPT_ARCHIVE_STORAGE_V1.md.

intent_id.description: The predecessor-independent latest content intent represented by this wrapper.

latestOrdering.description: The content intent total order, compared lexicographically by source_revision, occurrence_id, then operation_id only after revision_authority exactly matches. The persisted authority proves the revision belongs to the slot-durable, non-resettable project high-water mark rather than ephemeral runtime state.

revisionAuthority.description: The stable V1 revision domain is the enclosing (project_id, slot_scope, slot_id). Epoch rollover is not defined: restore the durable high-water mark or fail closed.
